name: Cyber-ART
detailed_description:
Cyber-ART is a clicker game where your goal is to collect artworks!

Every 3 hours, you receive a random piece of art, allowing you to continuously expand your collection! Drop rates every 3 hours*:

Common: 70%

Uncommon: 25%

Rare: 4.89%

Epic: 0.1%

Legendary: 0.01%

Ultra Rare: 1 in 400,000

Mythic: 1 in 10,000,000

No crafting system—drop rates are fixed! The rarest artworks are limited in quantity, and the difficulty of obtaining top-tier pieces increases every year!

Why you’ll love it: First and foremost, it’s a fun, free way to collect cyber-themed art—then it’s a clicker game! Lightweight and efficient, so you can run it worry-free. Test your luck and dedication to acquire ultra-rare collectibles! Join a vibrant art-themed community and even submit your own designs! Start your Cyber-ART journey now! 🎨✨
